title: QUIC RFC 9000 0-RTT Remembered Transport Parameter Policy Work Item
summary: Close the bounded RFC 9000 Section 7.4.1 client remembered transport-parameter policy floor by classifying known transport parameters, deriving a sanitized 0-RTT remembered subset, and gating dormant early-data readiness on that subset.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal QuicZeroRttTransportParameterPolicy with known transport-parameter identifiers and mandatory, optional, or prohibited 0-RTT storage classifications.
- Derive a sanitized ZeroRttTransportParameters snapshot from the raw peer transport-parameter snapshot when constructing a detached resumption ticket carrier.
- Preserve the raw peer snapshot for resumption metadata while using only the sanitized subset for HasEarlyDataPrerequisiteMaterial.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for classification coverage, prohibited-parameter exclusion, processable parameter retention, and prohibited-only snapshot rejection.
- Retarget S7P4P1 0001, 0002, and 0004 trace links to the focused proof instead of the broad RFC 9000 umbrella.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S7P4P1 and CRT resumption/0-RTT guard filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0005 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0013 server acceptance, restored-value support, and updated-value violation policy.
TLS early_data extension emission or acceptance.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused client remembered-transport-parameter policy and requirement-home proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0001, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0002, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0004.
